mapper.select: select config_version from execution_environment where not is_deleted and environment_id = #{id} for update
mapper.insert: insert into execution_namespace_owner(instance_id, adapter_type, catalog_name, schema_name, environment_id) values(#{input.connection.instanceId}, #{input.connection.type}, #{input.catalog}, #{input.schema}, #{id}) on conflict do nothing
mapper.sql: select e.environment_id, e.name, e.config_version, cast(v.execution as text) as execution from execution_environment e join execution_environment_version v on e.tenant_id = v.tenant_id and e.environment_id = v.environment_id and e.config_version = v.config_version and not v.is_deleted
mapper.select: where not e.is_deleted order by e.created_at, e.environment_id
